title: primalcraft
description: A lightweight Minecraft modpack featuring dinosaurs, improved AI, new animations, and optimized performance for low-end PCs.
body:
**PrimalCraft**

PrimalCraft is a Minecraft modpack that enhances the vanilla experience with dinosaurs, improved animations, new textures, and better player movement while staying optimized for low-end PCs.

The modpack focuses on creating a more immersive and dynamic survival experience. With new creatures, improved AI, and smoother gameplay mechanics, the world feels more alive and exciting to explore.

**Main Features**

* Dinosaurs and prehistoric creatures
* Improved mob AI for more engaging gameplay
* New player animations and movement improvements
* New textures and visual enhancements
* Optimized performance for low-powered computers
* Optional shaders included (3 different shaders)
* Better world rendering using Chunky

PrimalCraft is designed for players who want a richer Minecraft experience without sacrificing performance.

This is the first version of the modpack. If you encounter bugs or issues, please report them so they can be fixed in future updates.
